stages.name: Zig Sema (source to analyzed AIR)
stages.summary: The pinned upstream compiler's semantic analysis is believed to produce AIR that means what the Zig source means. Nothing relates source to AIR except bounded native/model differential tests.

stages.name: AIR JSON exporter patch
stages.summary: The exported structure is re-checked outside the Lean decoder: instruction ids, operand scoping, block/loop/dispatch targets, terminators, type-table/global references and the per-version tag set and unsupported markers of coverage/<version>.json. Operand values and the meaning of each tag remain trusted.

checks.what: independent structural validation of every committed golden AIR file
compiler-derived AIR tag/type inventory against checksum-pinned compiler sources
exported filename identity, re-export and collision contract

stages.name: JSON decode and schema/profile validation
stages.summary: Decoding is unproved Lean code. Its rejection policy (V05) is regression-tested; that the decoded value is the exported AIR is trusted. The independent validator checks the same input, not the decoder's output.

stages.name: Canonicalization (reference validation, copy forwarding, renumbering)
stages.summary: Rewrites are not proved to preserve meaning (V02 research). Evidence is golden Gen.lean comparison and mutation tests.

stages.name: Per-version tag normalization
stages.summary: The mapping from verbatim per-version AIR tags to Op constructors is unproved. scripts/normalize-air.py only normalizes identities for golden comparison and is not a check of this stage.

stages.name: Whole-program checker
stages.summary: Type, layout, global and call restrictions are enforced by unproved Lean code; acceptance does not certify that the admitted program is in the modeled subset.

stages.name: Lean emitter (Gen.lean)
stages.summary: Emission is not proved to preserve the canonical AIR. Evidence is golden Gen.lean comparison, mutation tests and bounded differential tests. Undefined values stay explicit: a store of `undefined` to a local is either a dead store (overwritten before any read) or the local becomes a byte local (`Zig.Bytes T`) whose undefined bytes read as `.unspecified`; partly undefined constant operands and global initializers are explicit undefined bytes or rejected (tests/roadmap/undef-locals, tests/roadmap/undef-operands).

stages.name: Artifact provenance (source, patch, AIR, profile, Gen.lean, runtime, toolchain)
stages.summary: Hash links between the artifacts of one run are recomputed and staleness is named per link. Identity is checked; correspondence between the linked artifacts is not.

checks.what: chained manifest hashes and per-link staleness

stages.name: ZigLean runtime semantics (model fidelity)
stages.summary: The runtime definitions are the meaning given to generated code. That they match Zig's semantics is a model choice; opaque/extern/implemented_by bodies are reviewed, not proved.

stages.name: Theorems over generated modules and the ZigLean library
stages.summary: Every shipped theorem about the generated Lean module, and every runtime lemma it uses, is checked by the Lean kernel, and every non-toolchain module of each audited dependency closure is replayed by the toolchain's independent leanchecker, so an elaborator bypass (debug.skipKernelTC) cannot enter the evidence. Every module the premise index lists (tutorials, case studies, tests/roadmap) is audited the same way. The audited dependency closure may use only the standard axioms and reviewed opaques. This is preservation inside the model only.

checks.what: kernel build of Proofs, then dependency/axiom/opaque/extern audit of the checked environment
kernel replay of every audited module and compiled audit of every indexed theorem module

stages.name: Lean kernel and toolchain
stages.summary: The pinned Lean kernel and the three standard axioms are the trusted base of every kernel-checked statement.

stages.name: Native backend, linker, OS and hardware
stages.summary: Proofs concern AIR before code generation. Native behavior is related to the model only by bounded differential runs and ABI-probe observations for named targets.
